requirements.title: Agent operating contract
requirements.notes: Agent.md identifies the payroll registry, status semantics, tagging rules, tenant scope, and deferred foundation scope.

requirements.title: Tenant-scoped payroll actions
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Payroll and attendance actions resolve/create records under authenticated tenant scope; attendance schedule/calendar derivation is tenant-scoped; employee OT derives employee/tenant identity from the authenticated session.

requirements.title: Payroll RBAC remains server-authoritative
requirements.notes: Payroll administration remains protected by requirePayrollAccess. Employee OT submission uses Role.EMPLOYEE and cannot self-approve.

requirements.title: Separate compensation basis, pay frequency, and attendance policy
requirements.notes: CompensationBasis, PayFrequency and AttendancePolicy are independently persisted. Legacy EmployeeProfile salary fields remain as compatibility mirrors during migration.

requirements.title: Effective-dated employee payroll configuration
requirements.notes: EmployeeCompensation versions are effective-dated, legacy rows are backfilled at hire date, admin changes create new versions, and payroll resolves the version effective on cutoff end date.

requirements.title: Historical configuration integrity
requirements.notes: New payslips persist compensationId plus immutable compensationSnapshot; retroactive payroll-term versions overlapping finalized/paid history are blocked. Full payroll revision/delta correction remains tracked separately under PAY-RUN-003.

requirements.title: Effective-dated schedules
requirements.notes: Effective range and overlap checks exist and schedule actions are tenant-hardened; exact-head acceptance evidence remains pending.

requirements.title: Attendance-derived payable time
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Calculation consumes payable attendance context through an explicit policy. Mobile Time In/Out recalculates attendance metrics using server-authoritative timestamps and tenant-scoped schedule/calendar data.

requirements.title: Auditable attendance corrections
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Original/adjusted JSON and approval evidence are retained. Direct edit/delete and correction approval are blocked for finalized/paid payroll dates.

requirements.title: Only approved overtime is payable
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Payroll refresh filters APPROVED overtime. Employee OT requests enter PENDING and require Payroll Manager review.

requirements.title: Deterministic calculation engine
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Pure explicit-policy calculation path and deterministic regression test are implemented.

requirements.title: Explicit calculation policy
requirements.notes: Calculation multipliers/hours are explicit policy inputs. The legacy wrapper is intentionally DEFERRED until effective-dated policy persistence exists and is not labeled as current law.

requirements.title: Non-negative rounded payroll totals
evidence: PR #161 exact-head HOAHub MySQL CI #1089 SUCCESS
requirements.notes: Engine clamps basic/net pay and rounds money.

requirements.title: Payroll-period deductions
requirements.notes: Draft-only normal maintenance is implemented and tenant-hardened.

requirements.title: Loan/cash advance repayment integrity
requirements.notes: Repayments are tenant-scoped, capped, and applied only when finalized payroll is marked paid; exact-head concurrency evidence is still required for VERIFIED.

requirements.title: Expanded payroll lifecycle
requirements.notes: Current enum is DRAFT/FINALIZED/PAID. Expansion requires schema migration and coordinated UI/action changes.

requirements.title: Finalization validation
requirements.notes: Tenant-scoped payslip-count and DRAFT checks plus audit exist; dedicated exact-head acceptance test remains pending.

requirements.title: Immutable finalized/paid evidence with correction path
requirements.notes: Finalized/paid attendance is immutable. Finalized payroll can only return to draft after a full pre-reopen PayrollArchive snapshot is created transactionally; finalized/paid payroll cannot be destructively deleted. Full first-class revision/delta/reversal persistence is still pending.

requirements.title: Effective-dated Philippine statutory rule sets
requirements.notes: Authoritative tables/effective dates and persistence model must be verified before production values are represented as current law.

requirements.title: Statutory rule snapshot
requirements.notes: Depends on PAY-STAT-001 and payroll revision snapshot model.

requirements.title: Idempotent payroll financial posting
requirements.notes: Finance posting contract and idempotency identity still need implementation.

requirements.title: Payroll finance outbox/retry/reconciliation
requirements.notes: Depends on finance posting contract.

requirements.title: Payroll expense/liability traceability
requirements.notes: Depends on finalized payroll revision model and Financial Engine mapping.
